title: Primitive nonnegative facet forms and facet vector
statement:
Let $P$ be a commutative monoid [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], written additively, with Grothendieck group $G=P^{m gp}$ and $\iota:P	o G$. A primitive nonnegative facet form of $P$ is a surjective homomorphism $
u:G	o\mathbf Z$ with $
u(\iota q)\geq0$ for all $q\in P$ such that the subgroup $H_
u\subset G$ generated by $\{\iota q: q\in P,\ 
u(\iota q)=0\}$ satisfies $\dim_{\mathbf Q}(\mathbf Q\otimes_{\mathbf Z}H_
u)+1=\dim_{\mathbf Q}(\mathbf Q\otimes_{\mathbf Z}G)$; for $P$ fine and saturated these are exactly the forms $
u_F$ with $F=\sigma\cap\ker
u_F$ a codimension-one face of the cone $\sigma\subset G\otimes\mathbf Q$ of $P$. For a finite set $\mathcal F$ in bijection with the facet forms, $F\mapsto
u_F$, the facet vector is the homomorphism $
u:G	o\mathbf Z^{\mathcal F}$, $g\mapsto(
u_F(g))_F$.
